name: Moura Encantada
body:
Moura Encantada
CR 6

This lovely lass has a winsome beauty with delicate features and voluptuous curves. Her skin is pale green and her hair shimmers like spun silver and gold, with leaves caught in her tresses.

XP 2,400
NG Medium fey (aquatic, shapechanger)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12; Aura blinding beauty (30 ft., DC 21)

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 42 (9d6+9)
Fort +6, Ref +10, Will +9
DR 5/cold iron Weaknesses enchanted bond

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee sickle +9 (1d6)
Ranged longbow +10 (1d8/×3)
Special Attacks charming glance
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +10)

Constant—speak with plants
At will—entangle (DC 15), tree shape, wood shape (1 lb. only) (DC 16)
3/day—charm person (DC 15), deep slumber (DC 17), tree stride
1/day—suggestion (DC 17)

Druid Spells Prepared (CL 7th, concentration +10)

4th—summon nature’s ally IV
3rd—call lightning (DC 16), cure moderate wounds, water breathing
2nd—barkskin, flame blade, resist energy, tree shape
1st—charm animal (DC 14), endure elements, entangle (DC 14), obscuring mist, produce flame
0—detect magic, guidance, light, stabilize

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 19, Con 13, Int 14, Wis 16, Cha 19
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 18
Feats Great Fortitude, Stealthy, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (longbow), Weapon Focus (sickle)
Skills Bluff +15, Climb +9, Craft (sculpture) +9 (+15 when affecting wood, and +2 circumstance bonus from masterwork tools), Diplomacy +16, Escape Artist +18, Handle Animal +10, Knowledge (nature) +11, Linguistics +3, Perception +12, Sense Motive +7, Sleight of Hand +8, Stealth +15, Survival +8, Swim +12, Use Magic Device +8
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with plants
SQ change shape (Small or Medium snake, beast shape I), tree meld, wild empathy +19, woodcraft

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Amphibious (Ex)

A moura encantada an survive indefinitely on land.

Blinding Beauty (Su)

Humanoids coming within 30 feet of a moura encantada and looking directly at her are blinded permanently (DC 21 Fort negates). A moura encantada can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Enchanted Bond (Su)

A moura encantada sickens and dies if she is forced to venture more than 1 mile from her bonded location or creature. She becomes sickened immediately and must make a DC 15 Fortitude save evey hour to avoid becoming nauseated for 1 hour. She takes 1d6 points of Constitution damage for every 24 hours she spends away from her enchanted bond until she dies. She can attune herself to a new location with a ritual taking 24 hours.

Spells (Su)

A moura encantada casts spells as a 7th-level druid, but she cannot swap out prepared spells to cast summon spells.

Dazing Glance (Su)

As a standard action, a moura encantada can overwhelm the thoughts and emotions of a creature she can see within 30 feet, causing the target to be dazed for 2d4 rounds (DC 21 Will negates). The save DC is Charisma-based.

Tree Meld (Su)

A moura encantada can meld her body into any tree large enough to contain her. This functions like meld into stone but has an unlimited duration.

Wild Empathy (Ex)

A moura encantada can influence the attitude of animals as the druid class feature, with a +6 racial bonus.

Woodcraft (Ex)

A moura encantada has a +6 competence bonus on Craft checks involving wood and is always treated as having masterwork tools for crafting wood.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary, pair, or grove (3–8)
Treasure standard (sickle, masterwork longbow with 20 arrows, other treasure)

Mouras are fey women as kindly as they are beautiful. Everyone who gazes upon a moura encantada tends to see them slightly differently according to their own inner image of beauty, though all find her to possess immense loveliness. They appear curiously ageless, with a youthful suppleness of skin and limb and yet eyes that speak of wisdom and experience and moving with a practiced grace and ease. Their hair is uniformly long, and they often disentangle it with princely combs of precious metal embellished with gemstones.

Mouras have the ability to transform into serpents and can be found near streams, springs, caves, and megalithic monuments, such as dolmens and burial mounds. Their souls are bound by a timeless enchantment to a specific location, and though no visible walls exist, they cannot stray far from this vicinity. For some, this binding also ties them to a specific creature, binding them as guardians of a creature or treasure. Bound mouras spend their days in a semi-lethargic state, with only one of two things on their minds: protecting the territory or escaping from their ‘prison.’ If the enchantment is broken, they return to the spirit-realm they call Mourama, and those who have paid the price will be rewarded. Breaking such an enchantment involves not battles, but rather demonstrations of love.
